messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the Russian-language ATP/WTA tennis season simulator’s playability and reliability, especially tournament brackets for non-power-of-two draws.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest one; use a full-size PNG only if fine detail matters.

## Decisions
- Use power-of-two bracket structures with byes for non-power-of-two draws.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented power-of-two brackets, bye resolution, bracket repair with compatible result retention, ceiling-based round counts, and guards against advancing completed matches or non-participants.
- Updated the bracket UI to show calculated rounds and identify bye advances.

### Active
- Fix batch match simulation so later matches in a round are not undone; distribute points only after tournament completion.
- Fix bracket repair’s draw-size cap and vacancy handling; invalidate stale results and recompute completion metadata when participants change.
- Correct round-based point awards and first-round exit points across draw sizes.
- Fix final-point statistics omission; review live-match resume/autosave scope.

### Blocked
- Build and lint have not been run because dependencies are missing (`node_modules`).

## Next Move
1. Fix batch simulation to set scores on the current tournament copy and distribute points only when the tournament is complete.
2. Fix bracket repair’s draw-size cap and vacancy handling; invalidate results and recompute completion metadata when participants change.
3. Correct round-based points and first-round exit awards, then verify byes, repair, tournament completion, and awards across draw sizes.
4. Address final-point statistics omission; decide whether to implement live-match resume/autosave.
5. Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` when dependencies are available.

## Relevant Files
- `src/engine/seasonManager.ts`: bracket generation, repair, byes, progression, simulation, and points.
- `src/App.tsx`: match handlers, tournament progression, and autosave.
- `src/components/MatchViewer.tsx`: interactive match state and final statistics.
- `src/types.ts`: tournament, match, and live-score types.
- `src/data/tournaments.ts`: schedule, draw sizes, and point values.
- `src/components/TournamentBracket.tsx`: bracket rounds and bye display.
- `src/utils/storage.ts`: autosave and save-slot handling.
- `package.json`: build and lint scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed modified `.gitignore`, `src/components/TournamentBracket.tsx`, and `src/engine/seasonManager.ts`, plus untracked `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- No tests exist under `src/**/*.{test,spec}.*`.
- `simulateEntireTournament` and `handleSimulateCurrentRound` iterate stale match objects while `advanceTournamentMatch` deep-clones the tournament; subsequent scores can be lost, and entire-tournament simulation finalizes points unconditionally.
- Bracket repair may fill intentional first-round byes with additional eligible players beyond `drawSize`.
- Valid-shape repair does not invalidate completed downstream results when repaired participants change and does not clear stale tournament completion/champion metadata.
- Round awards currently key off `roundName`; fallback participation points use `pointsR128 || pointsR64`, which may not match the actual first-round exit award for each draw size.
- In `MatchViewer`, completion captures `stats` before the final point’s `setStats` update is reflected, so saved statistics can omit the final point.
- Live-match progress is component-local despite `Match.liveScore` existing; restarting a viewer does not restore current game/point state. Calendar week ordering appears nondecreasing.

## Objective
- Improve the Russian-language ATP/WTA tennis season simulator’s reliability and playability, especially tournament brackets for non-power-of-two draws.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest one; use a full-size PNG only if fine detail matters.

## Decisions
- Use power-of-two bracket structures with byes for non-power-of-two draws.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented power-of-two brackets, bye resolution, bracket repair with compatible result retention, ceiling-based round counts, and guards against advancing completed matches or non-participants.
- Updated the bracket UI to show calculated rounds and identify bye advances.

### Active
- Fix batch match simulation so later matches in a round are not undone; distribute points only after tournament completion.
- Verify and refine `repairTournamentBracket`, especially preserving compatible results while enforcing `drawSize` and bye vacancies.
- Correct round-based point awards and first-round exit points across draw sizes.
- Address final-point statistics omission; decide whether to implement live-match resume/autosave.

### Blocked
- Build and lint have not been run because dependencies are missing (`node_modules`).

## Next Move
1. Fix batch simulation to set scores on the current tournament copy and distribute points only when the tournament is complete.
2. Verify and refine `repairTournamentBracket`, including draw-size caps, vacancies, stale results, and completion metadata.
3. Correct round-based points and first-round exit awards; verify byes, repairs, tournament completion, and awards across draw sizes.
4. Address final-point statistics omission; decide whether to implement live-match resume/autosave.
5. Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` when dependencies are available.

## Relevant Files
- `src/engine/seasonManager.ts`: bracket generation, repair, byes, progression, simulation, and points.
- `src/App.tsx`: match handlers, tournament progression, and autosave.
- `src/components/MatchViewer.tsx`: interactive match state and final statistics.
- `src/types.ts`: tournament, match, and live-score types.
- `src/data/tournaments.ts`: schedule, draw sizes, and point values.
- `src/components/TournamentBracket.tsx`: bracket rounds and bye display.
- `src/utils/storage.ts`: autosave and save-slot handling.
- `package.json`: build and lint scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. Latest observed status: modified `.gitignore`, `src/components/TournamentBracket.tsx`, and `src/engine/seasonManager.ts`; untracked `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- Recent inspection did not implement further changes; no tests exist under `src/**/*.{test,spec}.*`.
- `simulateEntireTournament` and `handleSimulateCurrentRound` iterate stale match objects while `advanceTournamentMatch` deep-clones the tournament; subsequent scores can be lost, and entire-tournament simulation finalizes points unconditionally.
- Round awards currently key off `roundName`; fallback participation points use `pointsR128 || pointsR64`, which may not match the actual first-round exit award for each draw size.
- In `MatchViewer`, completion captures `stats` before the final point’s `setStats` update is reflected, so saved statistics can omit the final point.
- Live-match progress is component-local despite `Match.liveScore` existing; restarting a viewer does not restore current game/point state.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the Russian-language ATP/WTA tennis season simulator’s reliability and playability, especially tournament brackets for non-power-of-two draws.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest one; use a full-size PNG only if fine detail matters.

## Decisions
- Use power-of-two bracket structures with byes for non-power-of-two draws.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented power-of-two brackets, bye resolution, bracket repair with compatible result retention, ceiling-based round counts, and guards against advancing completed matches or non-participants.
- Updated the bracket UI to show calculated rounds and identify bye advances.

### Active
- Fix batch match simulation so later matches in a round are not undone; distribute points only after tournament completion.
- Verify and refine `repairTournamentBracket`, including preserving compatible results while enforcing `drawSize` and bye vacancies.
- Correct round-based point awards and first-round exit points across draw sizes.
- Address final-point statistics omission; decide whether to implement live-match resume/autosave.

### Blocked
- Build and lint have not been run because dependencies are missing (`node_modules`).

## Next Move
1. Fix batch simulation to set scores on the current tournament copy and distribute points only when the tournament is complete.
2. Verify and refine `repairTournamentBracket`, including draw-size caps, vacancies, stale results, and completion metadata.
3. Correct round-based points and first-round exit awards; verify byes, repairs, tournament completion, and awards across draw sizes.
4. Address final-point statistics omission; decide whether to implement live-match resume/autosave.
5. Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` when dependencies are available.

## Relevant Files
- `src/engine/seasonManager.ts`: bracket generation, repair, byes, progression, simulation, and points.
- `src/App.tsx`: match handlers, tournament progression, and autosave.
- `src/components/MatchViewer.tsx`: interactive match state and final statistics.
- `src/types.ts`: tournament, match, and live-score types.
- `src/data/tournaments.ts`: schedule, draw sizes, and point values.
- `src/components/TournamentBracket.tsx`: bracket rounds and bye display.
- `src/utils/storage.ts`: autosave and save-slot handling.
- `package.json`: build and lint scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. Latest observed status: modified `.gitignore`, `src/components/TournamentBracket.tsx`, and `src/engine/seasonManager.ts`; untracked `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- Recent history involved reading relevant source files and checking `git status`; no further code changes or tests were made.
- No tests exist under `src/**/*.{test,spec}.*`.
- `simulateEntireTournament` and `handleSimulateCurrentRound` iterate stale match objects while `advanceTournamentMatch` deep-clones the tournament; subsequent scores can be lost, and entire-tournament simulation finalizes points unconditionally.
- Round awards currently key off `roundName`; fallback participation points use `pointsR128 || pointsR64`, which may not match the actual first-round exit award for each draw size.
- In `MatchViewer`, completion captures `stats` before the final point’s `setStats` update is reflected, so saved statistics can omit the final point.
- Live-match progress is component-local despite `Match.liveScore` existing; restarting a viewer does not restore current game/point state.

## Objective
- Improve the Russian-language ATP/WTA tennis season simulator’s reliability and playability, especially tournament brackets for non-power-of-two draws.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG screenshot (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest one; use a full-size PNG only if fine detail matters.

## Decisions
- Use power-of-two bracket structures with byes for non-power-of-two draws.
- Determine points awards from bracket rounds, rather than localized round-name strings.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented power-of-two brackets, bye resolution, bracket repair with compatible-result retention, ceiling-based round counts, and guards against advancing completed matches or non-participants.
- Updated the bracket UI to show calculated rounds and identify bye advances.
- Changed completed-match point awards to use bracket-round indices, including draw-size-specific first-round exit awards.

### Active
- Fix batch match simulation so later matches in a round are not undone; distribute points only after tournament completion.
- Verify and refine `repairTournamentBracket`, including draw-size caps, vacancies, stale results, and completion metadata.
- Check fallback participation-point awards and tournament completion/point distribution across draw sizes.
- Address final-point statistics omission; decide whether to implement live-match resume/autosave.

### Blocked
- Build and lint have not been run because dependencies are missing (`node_modules`).

## Next Move
1. Fix batch simulation to assign each simulated score to the current tournament copy before advancing the match, and only distribute points once the tournament is complete.
2. Verify and refine `repairTournamentBracket` across draw sizes, vacancies, stale results, preserved results, and completion metadata.
3. Correct fallback participation awards and test bye progression, tournament completion, and awards across draw sizes.
4. Address final-point statistics and decide whether live-match resume/autosave is in scope.
5. Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` when dependencies are available.

## Relevant Files
- `src/engine/seasonManager.ts`: bracket generation/repair, progression, simulation, and points.
- `src/App.tsx`: match handlers, batch simulation, tournament progression, and autosave.
- `src/components/MatchViewer.tsx`: interactive match state and final statistics.
- `src/types.ts`: tournament, match, and live-score types.
- `src/data/tournaments.ts`: schedule, draw sizes, and point values.
- `src/components/TournamentBracket.tsx`: bracket rounds and bye display.
- `src/utils/storage.ts`: autosave and save-slot handling.
- `package.json`: build and lint scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. Latest observed status included modified `.gitignore`, `src/components/TournamentBracket.tsx`, and `src/engine/seasonManager.ts`; untracked `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- `src/engine/seasonManager.ts` was further modified to award points by rounds remaining; fallback participation points still use `pointsR128 || pointsR64` and need review.
- `simulateEntireTournament` and `handleSimulateCurrentRound` iterate match objects while `advanceTournamentMatch` deep-clones the tournament, so later scores may be lost; entire-tournament simulation currently finalizes points unconditionally.
- In `MatchViewer`, match completion builds `finalScore` from `stats` before the final point’s `setStats` update is reflected, which may omit the final point.
- Live-match progress is component-local despite `Match.liveScore` existing; restarting the viewer does not restore current game/point state.
- No tests exist under `src/**/*.{test,spec}.*`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the Russian-language ATP/WTA season simulator’s reliability and playability, particularly tournament brackets for non-power-of-two draws.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Use power-of-two bracket structures with byes for non-power-of-two draws.
- Determine points awards from bracket rounds, rather than localized round-name strings.
- Live-match resume/autosave remains undecided; `Match.liveScore` exists but current match progress is component-local.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented power-of-two brackets, bye resolution, bracket repair with compatible-result retention, ceiling-based round counts, and guards against advancing completed matches or non-participants.
- Updated bracket UI to show calculated rounds and identify bye advances.
- Changed completed-match point awards to use bracket-round indices; guarded point distribution until tournament completion and made fallback participation awards draw-size-specific.
- Fixed score assignment before advancement in batch and current-round simulation.
- Used latest `pointStats` when constructing `MatchViewer`’s final score.
- Changed tournament finalization to return updated tournament/player state, adding `pointsDistributed` to prevent repeat point awards; call sites in `src/App.tsx` and `simulateEntireTournament` were updated.
- Added preservation of completed tournament records during bracket repair, avoiding redraws caused by subsequent ranking changes.
- Installed dependencies; `npm run build` and `npm run lint` both pass.
- A temporary bracket validation script passed draw sizes and entrant-count checks for bracket generation, bye progression, completion, and repeated finalization. Its historical-result equality assertion failed because repaired matches omit undefined properties and recompute bye metadata; completed results themselves appeared retained, but this needs a more precise check.
- `git diff --check` passed before the latest repair change.

### Active
- Refine bracket repair tests to compare completed match outcomes/scores rather than raw object equality; verify completed-result preservation under ranking changes.
- Check `repairTournamentBracket` with vacancies, stale results, compatible results, and completion metadata.
- Decide whether live-match resume/autosave is in scope.

### Blocked
